# Naive criteria trucking (Simply applied IC for rank selection)

(naive rank grid generate (1:min(n,p,q)) -> check SSE and apply IC -> plot over the naive rank grid)

```{r,fig.height=14,fig.width=12}

library(patchwork)

# 各 final_plot を保存するリストを初期化
final_plot_list <- list()

for (count in c(1:3)){
	
plist <- c(50,100,200,500)

p<-plist[count]
q<-plist[count]
k<-5
n<-100

set.seed(123)
simdata<-rdasim1(n = n,p = p,q = q,k = k,s2n = c(1,1))
X <- simdata$X
Y <- simdata$Y

minrank<-min(dim(X),dim(Y))

# 各プロットをリストで保存する
plot_list <- list()

motlist <- c("AIC", "BIC", "GIC", "BICP", "GCV")


Lambda <- rrr_lambda(Y = Y, X = X, penaltySVD = c("ann"))

f <- rrda.fit(Y = Y, X = X, nrank = 1:minrank, lambda = 0)
p_list <- rrda.predict(f, X)

pr<-length(p_list$rank)
pl<-length(p_list$lambda)
# Initialize matrix to store AIC values
AIC_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = pl, ncol = pr+1)
BIC_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = pl, ncol = pr+1)
GIC_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = pl, ncol = pr+1)
BICP_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = pl, ncol = pr+1)
GCV_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = pl, ncol = pr+1)
sse_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = pl, ncol = pr+1)

qrX <- qr(X)
rX <- qrX$rank
							
# Loop over all l and r values
for (l in 1:pl) {
	for (r in 0:pr) {
		if (r==0){
			sse <- sum(Y^2)
		}else{
			tempYhat <- p_list[[1]][[l]][[r]]
			sse <- sum((Y - tempYhat)^2)
		}
		
		
		df <- r * (rX + q - r)
		AIC_matrix[l, r+1] <- n * q * log(sse / (n * q)) + 2 * df
		BIC_matrix[l, r+1] <- n * q * log(sse / (n * q)) + log(n * q) * df
		GIC_matrix[l, r+1] <- n * q * log(sse / (n * q)) + log(log(n * q)) * log(p * q) * df
		BICP_matrix[l, r+1] <- n * q * log(sse / (n * q)) + 2 * log(p * q) * df
		GCV_matrix[l, r+1] <- n * q * sse / (n * q - df)^2
		sse_matrix[l, r+1] <- sse
	}
}

get_best_indices <- function(mat, name) {
	min_val <- min(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
	idx <- which(mat == min_val, arr.ind = TRUE)
	cat(name, "→ min:", min_val, "at l =", idx[1], ", r =", idx[2]-1, "\n")
	
	return(idx[2]-1)
}

# 各指標ごとに最良の (l, r) を表示

get_best_indices(AIC_matrix, "AIC")
get_best_indices(BIC_matrix, "BIC")
get_best_indices(GIC_matrix, "GIC")
get_best_indices(BICP_matrix, "BICP")
get_best_indices(GCV_matrix, "GCV")
get_best_indices(sse_matrix, "sse")

criteria_list <- list(
	sse =sse_matrix,
	logsse =log(sse_matrix),
	AIC = AIC_matrix,
	BIC = BIC_matrix,
	GIC = GIC_matrix,
	BICP = BICP_matrix,
	GCV = GCV_matrix

)
for (crit_name in names(criteria_list)) {
  mat <- criteria_list[[crit_name]]
  mot<-crit_name
  
  optimized_rank <- get_best_indices(mat, crit_name)
  
  # 安全に最小値を取得（全NA列の処理も含む）
  col_min <- sapply(1:ncol(mat), function(j) {
    col_vals <- mat[, j]
    if (all(is.na(col_vals))) {
      return(NA)
    } else {
      return(min(col_vals, na.rm = TRUE))
    }
  })
  
  # データフレーム化
  bic_table <- data.frame(
    rank = 0:(pr),
    IC = col_min
  )
  
#bic_table<-bic_table[1:100,]
finite_IC <- bic_table$IC[is.finite(bic_table$IC)]  # Inf, -Inf, NA を除外

y_min <- min(finite_IC, na.rm = TRUE)
y_max <- max(finite_IC, na.rm = TRUE)
y_range <- y_max - y_min


	if (mot  %in%  c("sse" ,"logsse")){
			g <- ggplot(bic_table, aes(x = rank, y = IC)) +
		geom_line(color = "black") +
		#geom_point(size=0.05) +
# 		  geom_vline(xintercept = optimized_rank, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
# 		　annotate("text", x = optimized_rank, y = max(bic_table$IC), 
#          label = "\u25BC", color = "red", size =4) +
# 	geom_vline(xintercept = k, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
# 			　annotate("text", x = k, y = min(bic_table$IC), 
#          label = "\u25B2", color = "blue", size =4, vjust = 1) +
		#labs(title = paste(mot,"vs Estimated Rank"), x = "Rank", y = mot) +
		labs(title = paste(paste0("",mot),"vs Rank"), x = "Rank", y = paste0("",mot)) +
		coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min - 0.07 * y_range, y_max),xlim = c(0,minrank)) +
		theme_minimal()

		
	} else {
		g <- ggplot(bic_table, aes(x = rank, y = IC)) +
		geom_line(color = "black") +
		#geom_point(size=0.05) +
		  geom_vline(xintercept = optimized_rank, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
		　annotate("text", x = optimized_rank, y = max(bic_table$IC), 
         label = "\u25BC", color = "red", size =4) +
	geom_vline(xintercept = k, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
			　annotate("text", x = k, y = min(bic_table$IC), 
         label = "\u25B2", color = "blue", size =4, vjust = 1) +
		#labs(title = paste(mot,"vs Estimated Rank"), x = "Rank", y = mot) +
		labs(title = paste(paste0("",mot),"vs Rank"), x = "Rank", y = paste0("",mot)) +
		coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min - 0.07 * y_range, y_max),xlim = c(0,minrank)) +
		theme_minimal()

	}
	

  
  # リストに保存
  plot_list[[crit_name]] <- g
}
	
#rrda_result <- rrda.cv(Y = Y, X = X, maxrank =c(40,80,80,80)[count] , lambda = Lambda)
#saveRDS(rrda_result,here("out",paste0("rrda",count,"_s2n1.rds")))
#rrda_result<-readRDS(here("out",paste0("rrda",count,"_s2n1.rds")))

file_path <- here("out", paste0("rrda", count, "_s2n1.rds"))

if (file.exists(file_path)) {
  rrda_result <- readRDS(file_path)
} else {
  rrda_result <- rrda.cv(
    Y = Y, 
    X = X, 
    maxrank = c(40, 80, 80, 80)[count], 
    lambda = Lambda
  )
  saveRDS(rrda_result, file_path)
}

optimized_rank<- rrda_result$opt_min$rank
rank_estimates <- apply(rrda_result$MSE, 1, min)
bic_table <- data.frame(
	rank = rrda_result$rank,
	IC = rank_estimates
)

y_min <- min(bic_table$IC)
y_max <- max(bic_table$IC)
y_range <- y_max - y_min

g_cv <- ggplot(bic_table, aes(x = rank, y = IC)) +
	geom_line(color = "black") +
	#geom_point(size=0.05) +
	geom_vline(xintercept = optimized_rank, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
　annotate("text", x = optimized_rank, y = max(bic_table$IC), 
         label = "\u25BC", color = "red", size =4) +
	geom_vline(xintercept = k, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
	annotate("text", x = k, y = min(bic_table$IC), 
         label = "\u25B2", color = "blue", size =4, vjust = 1) +
	#labs(title = "5-fold CV vs Estimated Rank", x = "Rank", y = "CV-MSE") +
	labs(title = "5-fold rrda.CV vs Rank", x = "Rank", y = "RRDA.CV (MSE)") +
	coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min - 0.07 * y_range, y_max),xlim = c(0,minrank)) +
	theme_minimal()

plot_list[["CV"]] <- g_cv


# patchwork で結合（例: 3列 × 3行）
combined_plot <- (  plot_list[[1]] / plot_list[[2]] / plot_list[[3]]) /
	plot_list[[4]] / plot_list[[5]]  / plot_list[[6]]  / plot_list[[7]] /	plot_list[["CV"]] 
 #/ plot_list[["StARS"]] / plot_list[["StARS2"]] 

tl<-c("n = 100 > p = q = 50",   "n = p = q = 100",   "n = 100 < p = q = 200","n = 100 < p = q = 500")

final_plot <- combined_plot + 
  plot_annotation(
    title = tl[count],
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"))
  )
# 表示
#print(final_plot)

final_plot_list[[count]] <- final_plot
}

wrapped_final_plots <- lapply(final_plot_list, wrap_elements)

# 横に並べて表示
all_combined_plot <- wrap_plots(wrapped_final_plots, nrow = 1)

print(all_combined_plot)

```

# ANN based trucking 

(ANN -> rank grid generate -> check SSE and apply IC -> plot over the ANN rank grid)

```{r,fig.height=17,fig.width=14}


library(patchwork)

# 各 final_plot を保存するリストを初期化
final_plot_list <- list()

for (count in c(1:3)){
	
plist <- c(50,100,200,500)

p<-plist[count]
k<-5

set.seed(123)
simdata<-rdasim1(n = 100,p = p,q = p,k = k,s2n = c(1,1))
X <- simdata$X
Y <- simdata$Y

minrank<-min(dim(X),dim(Y))

# 各プロットをリストで保存する
plot_list <- list()


##ic

motlist <- c("AIC", "BIC", "GIC", "BICP", "GCV")

Lambda <- rrr_lambda(Y = Y, X = X, penaltySVD = c("ann"))

for (mot in motlist){
	#rrr_result <- rrr(Y = Y, X = X, penaltySVD = c("ann"), ic.type = mot,maxrank=100)
	#saveRDS(rrr_result,here("out",paste0("rrda",count,mot,"_s2n1.rds")))
	#rrr_result <- readRDS(here("out",paste0("rrda",count,mot,"_s2n1.rds")))
	
	file_path <- here("out", paste0("rrda", count, mot, "_s2n1.rds"))

	if (file.exists(file_path)) {
	  rrr_result <- readRDS(file_path)
	} else {
	  rrr_result <- rrr(
	    Y = Y, 
	    X = X, 
	    penaltySVD = c("ann"), 
	    ic.type = mot, 
	    maxrank = 100
	  )
	  saveRDS(rrr_result, file_path)
	}
		
	
	idx_min <- which.min(rrr_result$ic)
	optimized_rank <- rrr_result$rank
	
	optimized_lambda <- rrr_result$lambda[idx_min]
	
	rank_estimates <- colSums(rrr_result$Spath != 0)
	
	bic_table <- data.frame(
		lambda = Lambda,
		rank = rank_estimates,
		IC = rrr_result$ic
	)
	
	y_min <- min(bic_table$IC)
y_max <- max(bic_table$IC)
y_range <- y_max - y_min
	
	
	g <- ggplot(bic_table, aes(x = rank, y = IC)) +
		geom_line(color = "black") +
		#geom_point(size=0.05) +
		  geom_vline(xintercept = optimized_rank, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
		　annotate("text", x = optimized_rank, y = max(bic_table$IC), 
         label = "\u25BC", color = "red", size =4) +
	geom_vline(xintercept = k, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
			　annotate("text", x = k, y = min(bic_table$IC), 
         label = "\u25B2", color = "blue", size =4, vjust = 1) +
		labs(title = paste(paste0("ANN.",mot),"vs Estimated Rank"), x = "Rank", y = paste0("ANN.",mot)) +
		coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min - 0.07 * y_range, y_max),xlim = c(0,minrank)) +
		theme_minimal()
	
	plot_list[[mot]] <- g
}


# sse (from rrr)



	rrr_result <- readRDS(here("out",paste0("rrda",count,"AIC","_s2n1.rds")))
	
	rank_estimates <- colSums(rrr_result$Spath != 0)
	
	
	mot<- "ANN.sse"

	bic_table <- data.frame(
```
